title: Migrate Tactus marketing site: standard header/footer and Markus prose

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started. Findings: Tactus-web already renders most pages through Markus (publication/) inside chrome scraped from a Gatsby donor page; Gatsby still owns header/footer/CSS, 3 orphan MDX example pages, demo-animated-square. Plan: full migration to the standard Papyrus site (web/projection.json, site-theme.css, hooks.py), content in repo content/ with core page blocks, islands in one esbuild bundle mounted via ::island, Gatsby removed. Core gap found: directory source only supports one directory level; need nested slugs for /examples/<chapter>/<example>/ (small core PR).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Migration built locally on branch feature/PPY-ef5843-papyrus-front-end (Tactus-web). Parity vs live snapshot: 69 URLs compared, 0 blocking diffs, main content (text, headings, links, images, code, islands, video) identical on 66 pages; head/og diffs allow-listed. Layout: 63 of 68 pages within 40px total height at 1440 (footer included); pixel-identical down to the footer on sampled pages. Core PRs: #427 nested directory slugs (merged), #424 page blocks + family footer (footer rewritten to mirror anthus-footer main, fence fix, goldens, guard fixes) in CI, PPY-c9952a islands/buttons inside cards ready to follow. Waiting for core 5.2.0 release to pin requirements.

comments.author: home
comments.text: LIVE and verified. Tactus-web PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Tactus-web/pull/13 merged to main (CI green). Amplify app dfkbdffs2viq8 (account 335163751677, profile legacy), job 110 SUCCEED (previous good job 109). Core: #427 nested directory slugs, #424 page blocks + islands + family footer (footer rewritten to mirror anthus-footer main, longer-fence fix, locked-Markus goldens, guard fixes), #434 islands/buttons inside cards, #435 footer.family logo; promoted via #430; released papyrus-newsroom 5.4.0 (pinned in requirements-publication.txt). Parity vs pre-migration live snapshot: 68 pages, main content (text, headings, links, images, code, islands, video) identical on 65, 3 orphan MDX pages differ for listed reasons; 0 blocking diffs; head/OG diffs allow-listed (canonical, og:url, twitter:large card, descriptions clipped at 300, og:title without suffix, 404 text). Pixel diff at 1440: sampled pages identical from header to footer; at 390 content identical, footer differs. Live check after deploy: 83 URLs return the expected status; 69 HTML pages are byte-identical to the local build; /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, .md twins, llms.txt, manifest all served; /features -> 301 /features/. Removed on purpose: /demo-animated-square/, /page-2/, /using-typescript/, /404/. Follow-ups filed on the Tactus board: tctw-48a90f (guardrails #sandboxing anchor), tctw-df2f4a (fonts never loaded), tctw-0e9cbd (orphan example pages), tctw-a5a59a (dark scheme compare).
